title: Insurance Claim Number
text: A claim number is an identifier assigned to an insurance claim. It is used to reference that claim.

title: Insurance Deductible
text: A deductible is an amount a policyholder may need to pay under an insurance policy. Whether a deductible applies depends on the policy terms.

title: Insurance Premium
text: An insurance premium is the amount paid for insurance coverage under an insurance agreement.

title: Motor Insurance
text: Motor insurance provides coverage for specified vehicle-related risks, subject to the terms, conditions and exclusions of the policy.

title: General Claim Status
text: A claim status describes the current stage of an insurance claim. The actual status of a specific claim must be retrieved from an authorized claims system.
